source: Pat's answers of 2026-11-05: each block of exercises from Green to Indigo has its cool-down; Red, Orange and Yellow end each rhyme with their own. Only Green's Cool Down 1 has been sent so far.

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 1
coolDowns.text:
Touch your head, touch your nose, touch your knee.
Stand straight, feet together. Count to 10.
